# CNA Camp

> Treks, camps and outdoor adventures across Gujarat, the Himalaya and North-East India since 1997. Based in Rajkot, India, CNA Camp is backed by Saurashtra Education & Charitable Trust.

## Official resources
- [CNA Camp website](https://cnacamp.com/): Official site and current trip information.
- [XML sitemap](https://cnacamp.com/sitemap.xml): Indexable public pages, published trips and published blog posts.

## Explore
- [Treks and camps](https://cnacamp.com/trips): Trip descriptions and itineraries.
- [Upcoming batches](https://cnacamp.com/batches): Scheduled departures and availability.
- [Group trips](https://cnacamp.com/group-trips): Group travel information.
- [Travellers](https://cnacamp.com/travellers): Information for different traveller groups.
- [About CNA Camp](https://cnacamp.com/about): Organization background.
- [Gallery](https://cnacamp.com/gallery): Trip photos and videos.
- [Travel blog](https://cnacamp.com/blog): Articles and travel guides.
- [Contact](https://cnacamp.com/contact): Enquiries and booking questions.

## Guidance
- Refer to the relevant trip or batch page for current itinerary, dates, pricing and availability.
- For bookings or details not listed online, use the [contact page](https://cnacamp.com/contact).
